issues.description: The template Lecture.java pre-declares lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public fields, but the problem statement UML and the solution use private fields with getters/setters for all attributes. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about whether to keep public fields or to change them to private and implement getters/setters as requested.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, declare all attributes from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) as private (in the same order as the UML) instead of leaving some as public. Keep the getters/setters and constructor as the parts students must implement so the template aligns with the UML and the solution.
